Answer: F
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification (white-out) of the left hemithorax with a significant mediastinal shift to the right (towards the opacity). This combination indicates massive volume loss in the left lung, which is characteristic of total lung atelectasis (collapse), whereas pleural effusion or a mass would typically push the mediastinum away (to the left).
